title: Jewelry That Moves: 17 Transformable and Secret-Keeping Pieces for Fall
text: Independent designers today have to be more creative than ever before with gold prices still high and the different challenges at the retail end. Many of them have met these challenges head on with transformable or interchangeable pieces that are multifunctional, offering the wearer built-in versatility and added value to a jewelry wardrobe. There are also inventive moveable pieces that spin, are double sided and/or open up to reveal secret messages and compartments and are both fun and meaningful. Both of these jewelry themes are inspired by the past but are reinvigorated with a modern sensibility and are perfect to add to your selection as we head into fall and the holiday season. By Beth Bernstein Transform Don’t Conform These pieces can have module units or components. They take shape in different chains with add-on links and medallions, charm holders and hoop or huggie earrings that can be worn with or without pendants and drops, gemstone slides that can be added on or taken off leather cord or chain. There are also one-of-a-kind intricate and artfully designed reversible bracelets and pendants.
